data.name: Japhethiel
data.gender_notes: Japhethiel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Japhethiel is recorded in name-lists as “God may enlarge”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Japhethiel expresses “God may enlarge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Japhethiel total 49, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_greek.name: Ἰαφεθἰηλ
in_greek.meaning: ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰαφεθ + ἰηλ = υἱός Ἰαφεθ
in_greek.long_meaning: ἐξ οὗ Ἰαφεθ, τοῦ γινομένου υἱοῦ Γοθονίου, ἡ Ἰαφεθἰηλ ὁ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἀνήρ, ὅς ἐκ τοῦ Ἰαφεθ τοῦ γένους Ἰαφεθ ἠλέητεύθη· καὶ ὅτι ἡ Ἰαφεθἰηλ ἡ τοῦ Θεοῦ σπέρμα, ἡ τοῦ Χριστοῦ πίστις, ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ζωή

in_latin.name: Japhethiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Japhethiel, nomen Christianum, a Japheth, filio Gomer, ortum, qui in ecclesia Christi fuit, et per Japheth, filium Gomer, in filium Dei mutatus est; et Japhethiel, qui fuit in filio Dei, et in filio Christi, et in Spiritu Sancto vivit
